description: Tauron customer account: payments and invoices.
notes: Login happens on logowanie.tauron.pl with the login and password secrets. After login the home page shows 'Najbliższa płatność' with the amount, 'Po terminie: N dni' when overdue, and each item's 'Termin' date. Invoices (Faktury) are listed newest first by issue date; expand the list with 'Rozwiń'. The latest invoice is the first row: open it and download its PDF once. Do not filter by date range. A finished download appears in the tab's downloads; do not click it again.

steps.goal: Click the link named Faktury i płatności, then open Faktury.
